Update by hand only; re-verify sha256. Vendored from the registry tarball and
never from a CDN URL, for the reason echarts/PINNED.txt records: CDNs resolve
version specifiers loosely.

Why this is here at all: ADR-0007 ratifies FastAPI + Jinja2 + HTMX, and ADR-0008
(Local First) requires the app to render with no network, so the library is
vendored like echarts rather than linked. components.css already styles
`.htmx-indicator` and static/js/charts.js already binds `htmx:load` /
`htmx:beforeSwap`; this is the library those two were written against.
